Myanmar migrant workers rush to renew permits

๒๔ มิ.ย. ๒๕๖๔ • 22:02 น.

Thousands of Myanmar migrant workers queued in Samut Sakhon on Monday to renew their work permits before the deadline set by the Labour Ministry.

Officials said more than 2 million migrants from Myanmar, Cambodia and Laos are registered under MOU agreements, while employers urged the government to extend the deadline.
